known.via: English Wikipedia "Ribera del Andarax" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra (IGP) covering twenty municipalities in Almería province, including Canjáyar, Gérgal and Ohanes. It sits one step below the DO level on the Spanish quality ladder and gained its status in 2003.
